properties.level_of_theory: PM7 (Gaussian 16), gas phase, isolated molecule (matrix-isolation regime)
properties.note: rectangular (D2h) ground-state minimum, C-C 1.347/1.551 A, 18 real frequencies, 0 imaginary

square (D4h-like) structure with all four ring C-C fixed at 1.480 A and the hydrogens relaxed; PM7 gives no clean first-order saddle for the bond-alternation coordinate (opt=TS from near-square guesses collapses back to the rectangular minimum), so the square was evaluated by a bond-length-constrained optimisation
Kekule-shifted (automerized) rectangular form; degenerate with R by symmetry
